persona.name: Sofia Lindqvist
persona.summary: Full-stack engineer with about five years of experience and far more material than fits on one page
persona.background: Works on a healthcare scheduling product in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL. Previously built Rails subscription features at a retailer, and started with a web development internship at an agency. Applying for full-stack, frontend, QA-adjacent, and Rails roles.
goals: Keep a one-page resume while choosing the right bullets for each role
Bring older Rails work forward for Rails roles
frustrations: Cutting good bullets by hand for every application
Older but relevant experience gets buried below recent work
evaluator_notes: Has 16 experience bullets; a one-page draft cannot include them all
Rails experience is 1 year 9 months, close to but below a 2-year threshold
Mentoring is real but she has never had a formal lead title

bullets.bullet_text: Lead development of the patient appointment-booking flow in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, used by 120 clinics
Designed a GraphQL API over PostgreSQL that replaced 30 REST endpoints for the patient portal
Built HIPAA audit logging for patient-record access, reviewed and approved by the compliance team
Cut the patient portal bundle size by 38% by code-splitting routes and removing unused dependencies
Introduced Cypress end-to-end tests for booking and messaging that caught 11 regressions before release in the first quarter
Mentor two junior engineers through weekly pairing and code review
Moved scheduled reminder jobs to AWS Lambda and EventBridge, reducing server costs by about $1,400 per month
Built subscription billing features in a Ruby on Rails monolith integrated with Stripe
Optimized MySQL queries for the order history page, cutting load time from 4.1s to 0.9s
Wrote RSpec and Jest tests that raised checkout test coverage from 52% to 80%
Migrated the product listing pages from jQuery to React
Added Sidekiq background jobs for order confirmation emails
Built and maintained WordPress sites in PHP for 15 small-business clients
Created custom JavaScript and jQuery interactions from agency designs
Handled client support requests and site updates
Raised Lighthouse accessibility scores on client sites to 90 or above
Built a trip planner with offline maps that has 2,300 monthly active users

projects.description: GitHub Action that runs accessibility checks on pull requests

bullets.bullet_text: Published a GitHub Action that runs axe-core checks on preview deployments, used by 40 public repositories
Wrote a command-line budgeting tool in Ruby that imports bank CSV exports
